_comment: Hand-curated Halloween seed data. NOT API-driven. 'dates' is deliberately 'Check site' on every entry: these are annual events whose 2026 dates were not published at the time of writing, and inventing them would be worse than sending a parent to the source. 'verified' means 'we are confident this event exists and runs annually' — false entries are surfaced in the UI with a 'Confirm dates on their site' line rather than hidden.

events.name: Half Moon Bay Art & Pumpkin Festival
events.address: Main Street, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019
events.notes: Enormous street fair with a costume parade and the championship pumpkin weigh-off. Free to enter, but Highway 1 backs up for miles — go early or take the shuttle.

events.name: Lemos Farm
events.address: 12320 San Mateo Rd, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019
events.notes: Pony rides, a little train and a mildly spooky barn aimed at under-8s. Weekday mornings are far calmer than any weekend.

events.name: Arata's Pumpkin Farm
events.address: 185 Verde Rd, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019
events.notes: The famous hay maze has dark, enclosed stretches and people who jump out — plenty of under-10s tap out halfway. The patch itself is completely calm and you can skip the maze.

events.name: Spina Farms Pumpkin Patch
events.address: Santa Teresa Blvd & Bailey Ave, San Jose, CA 95141
events.notes: Classic open-air Coyote Valley patch — hay pyramid, tractor rides, no soundtrack and nothing that jumps. Ownership and site have shifted in recent years, so confirm it is open before the drive.

events.name: Webb Ranch Pumpkin Patch
events.notes: Small, quiet and close to Palo Alto — pony rides and a field of pumpkins without the festival crowds or the sound system.

events.name: Happy Hollow Park & Zoo Halloween
events.notes: Daytime trick-or-treat stations around the zoo with zero jump scares by design. Costumes yes, full face masks no — the rides ask you to take them off.

events.name: Children's Discovery Museum Halloween
events.notes: Indoor, daytime and entirely predictable — the safest pick if crowds and darkness are the actual problem. Members usually get the quieter early slot.

events.name: CuriOdyssey Halloween
events.address: 1651 Coyote Point Dr, San Mateo, CA 94401
events.notes: Science-museum-and-animals take on Halloween, mostly outdoors on the bay. Small scale, lots of room to step away when it gets busy.

events.name: Ardenwood Historic Farm Harvest Days
events.notes: Working farm with pumpkins, corn grinding and a horse-drawn train. Acres of open space, so there is always somewhere quiet to retreat to.

events.name: Great Pumpkin Fest at Great America
events.address: 4701 Great America Pkwy, Santa Clara, CA 95054
events.notes: Daytime, Snoopy-themed and deliberately scare-free — it wraps up before the Haunt actors come out. Do not confuse the two when booking.

events.name: Halloween Haunt at Great America
events.address: 4701 Great America Pkwy, Santa Clara, CA 95054
events.notes: After-dark scare zones with roaming actors who follow you. Genuinely not for under-13s, whatever they tell you at the gate.

events.name: Winchester Mystery House after-dark Halloween tour
events.address: 525 S Winchester Blvd, San Jose, CA 95128
events.notes: Live actors in a genuinely dark, genuinely strange house. The ordinary daytime mansion tour is the same building with none of that, and younger kids love it.

events.name: Hallowe'en on Murphy Avenue
events.notes: Downtown closes the street and the shops hand out candy in the early evening. Shoulder-to-shoulder by 6pm — arrive at the start if you have a stroller.

events.name: Downtown Castro Street Trick-or-Treat
events.notes: Shopfront trick-or-treating along Castro while it is still light. Flat, walkable and stroller-friendly, but packed at peak.

events.name: Cupertino Library Halloween Storytime
events.notes: Indoor, quiet and short enough for a toddler's attention span. Costumes welcome; check the branch calendar because seats go fast.

events.name: Palo Alto Children's Library Halloween Storytime
events.notes: The little storybook library does a gentle seasonal storytime. Low lights, no soundtrack, and the garden outside if it gets much.

events.name: Saratoga Village Trick-or-Treat
events.notes: Big Basin Way merchants hand out sweets in the late afternoon. Small, walkable and markedly calmer than the bigger downtown events.

events.name: Fremont Trunk-or-Treat
events.address: Location varies — see the city events calendar
events.notes: Decorated car boots in a closed car park — contained, well lit and no dark corners. The venue moves year to year, so check before setting off.
